records.text: An anonymous investigation source told Owens that local messages around 7 p.m. on September 11 said Tyler Robinson was already in custody.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep 2WEHTk0Xewg)

appearances.snippet: when everybody locally began receiving the text messages that Tyler Robinson was in custody and that they were going to pick him up in Warner Valley

verification.notes: The claim mixes accurate and inaccurate timing. Tyler Robinson was taken into custody on Sept 11, 2025, but not at 7pm - official sources confirm he was arrested at approximately 10pm at the Washington County Sheriff's Office in Hurricane, Utah. The 'Warner Valley' location is approximate - Robinson's parents lived in Washington, Utah (near Warner Valley area in Washington County). Local texts may have circulated around 7pm about the suspect being identified, but the actual arrest occurred at 10pm, making the total manhunt 33 hours from the shooting.

records.text: An anonymous investigation source told Owens that Tyler Robinson's mother recognized him, called him, and heard him say, 'Mom, I'm sick.'
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep 2WEHTk0Xewg)

appearances.snippet: So they released the photo, and then we are told—as my source initially told me—that it was the mother who recognized Tyler, and she phones him up. ... Tyler says, "Mom, I'm sick." She doesn't believe it. She loops in Dad, okay? Dad then texts, and he calls Tyler.

verification.notes: Confirmed that Tyler Robinson's mother (not 'the mother' but his mother specifically) saw surveillance images on news and recognized Tyler, then contacted him. Court documents confirm she showed photos to father who agreed it looked like their son.

This is hearsay from an anonymous source and cannot be independently verified. The speaker is relaying second-hand information from a source they cannot publicly identify. Without access to arrest records, booking photos, or official police documentation, and without knowing the identity or credibility of the source, this claim remains unverifiable.
